# Native cube project fixture

`orca-2.4.2-cube.3mf` was generated by the installed OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 CLI from the repository's twelve-triangle `cube.stl`, using bundled `Prusa MK4 0.4 nozzle`, `0.20mm Standard @MK4`, and `Prusa Generic PLA @MK4` presets. The process overrides were layer height 0.16 mm and outer-wall speed 70 mm/s. A temporary `--datadir` isolated all native configuration. No user account configuration or printer connection secrets are included.

Generation flags were `--arrange 0 --orient 0 --datadir <temporary-config> --load-settings <printer.json>;<process.json> --load-filaments <filament.json> --export-3mf <native.3mf> <model.stl>`.

The native acceptance suite generates its own fresh native project on every run and requires engine version 2.4.2. The checked-in fixture supplies deterministic parser unit tests without requiring the native executable.
